arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data (in thousands of dollars)
ny_2010 = 200209720
ny_2015 = 269716999
ny_2024_actual = 384447300

# Calculate CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015 (5 years)
years_2010_2015 = 5
cagr = (ny_2015 / ny_2010) ** (1/years_2010_2015) - 1
print(f"CAGR (2010-2015): {cagr:.6f} or {cagr*100:.4f}%")

# Project FY 2024 using CAGR from FY 2015 base
years_2015_2024 = 9
ny_2024_projected = ny_2015 * ((1 + cagr) ** years_2015_2024)
print(f"Projected FY 2024: {ny_2024_projected:,.0f} thousand")
print(f"Actual FY 2024: {ny_2024_actual:,.0f} thousand")

# Calculate percentage difference relative to actual
# (Projected - Actual) / Actual * 100
pct_diff = ((ny_2024_projected - ny_2024_actual) / ny_2024_actual) * 100
print(f"Percentage difference (relative to actual): {pct_diff:.4f}%")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(pct_diff, 2)}%")
EOF
